list.title: Dive-site library
list.description: Save a place once, then attach it to any dive on any trip — a two-tank day can visit one site twice or two different sites. Copy a site before tailoring a special itinerary.
list.siteArchivedNotice: Site archived. Trips that already visited it keep it.
list.emptyHeading: Start with a site your crew knows well
list.emptyBody: Add a location, a map or route image, and the life divers may encounter.
list.noMatchBody: Try another name or location, or clear the search to see the whole library.
list.templateUpdateReady: Template update v{version} ready — your edits are safe.
list.addBriefingFallback: Add the site notes your divers will see.

catalog.title: DiveDay common dive sites
catalog.description: Published, versioned starting points. Importing makes an independent site in your own library; later template updates never overwrite your edits.

form.forecastDescription: Use the offshore dive point, not the shop address. Leave both blank to keep crew-only conditions.
form.photosDescription: Upload the pictures a diver sees on this site's briefing. They are stored with your shop, so a briefing page never has to reach out to anyone else's server to draw them.
form.tooManyPhotos: {max, plural, one {A site holds up to # photo.} other {A site holds up to # photos.}}

route.description: Click the map to drop a waypoint, in the order you swim them. The map can't be dragged — it's fixed to this site's coordinates and zoom, so the line you draw is the line a diver sees.
route.needsCoordinates: Fill in the forecast latitude and longitude above and the map appears here, ready to draw on.
route.notePlaceholder: A relaxed sweep from the mooring along the coral ridge and back.
route.mapAriaLabel: Map — click to add a route waypoint

status.one: One waypoint down — click where it goes next.
status.some: {count} waypoints. Click to add another, or Undo to take one back.
status.full: That's the most waypoints a route can carry ({count}). Undo to change one.

form.maxDepthHint: (optional · warns when a diver's card doesn't reach it)
form.expectedBottomTimeHint: (optional · overrides your shop's usual bottom time)
form.divePlanPlaceholder: Entry, route, turnaround, and exit notes.
form.noLevelRequired: No level required by the site
form.errorCoordinates: Add both forecast coordinates, or leave both blank — a forecast point needs a latitude and a longitude. Everything else you typed is still here.
form.errorDepth: That maximum depth is deeper than any dive site — check the figure, then save again.
form.errorImages: One of those photos couldn't be stored — a site holds up to six, and each has to be a JPG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC under 5 MB. Everything else you typed is still here.
form.errorImagesUnconfigured: Photo storage isn't set up for this shop yet — save the briefing without photos for now, or ask your shop's owner or manager to configure it.

edit.description: Changes reach every upcoming dive that visits this site.
edit.archiveConfirmBody: Trips that already visited it keep it; new trips will no longer see this site.
edit.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the name and links, then try again.
edit.certificationDescription: What this site itself demands. Every trip that visits enforces at least this — when the trip asks for more, the stricter rule wins.

new.title: Add a dive site
new.description: Everything is optional except the name. Keep it useful, vivid, and true to the site.
new.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the required name and links, then try again.
new.certificationDescription: These requirements travel with the site into every new trip that uses it.
